items.title: Jay Leonhart interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Mike Longo, the pianist who you may know, he and I had a trio with a drummer named Jimmy Young

ctx.x: Eventually you went to New York?

Yeah. I went to New York in 1960 — no that’s not right — ‘61. I went up to Oscar Peterson’s School in Toronto in ‘60, I remember turning 21 in a little apartment, on a cold winter night in Toronto on December 6th. All of a sudden I said I’m 21. I bought myself a quart of beer and celebrated. And Mike Longo, the pianist who you may know, he and I had a trio with a drummer named Jimmy Young, and we moved to New York together in April of ‘61. I started working at the Playboy Club and —
Was there pretty fierce competition for gigs like that?
